changes.summary: Add the automation graphs ADR and the native workflow amendment to extension-runtime; documentation only, no runtime or public API change.

Filter chips: a nullable field offers the "is empty" operator (filterq.OpEmpty, wire form `field:empty:`, filterbuilder.FieldDef.Nullable, Solid FilterBuilderField.nullable); filterq.AppendSQL renders a FilterSet as PostgreSQL predicates from a field → column map (custom predicates for computed fields), and Condition.MatchValue/MatchValues/MatchBool/MatchDate/MatchNumber apply the same semantics to lists assembled in memory. Scaffold tables take a filter chip bar through table.WithFilterBar(bar, oob): it sits under the toolbar on every screen width instead of being folded into the mobile filters drawer, renders once, and re-renders out-of-band on row swaps. TableDefinition.WithFilterBar does the same for definition-built tables. filterq.RepoFilters turns chips into repo.FieldFilter values for pkg/repo repositories. The finance accounts list (/finance/accounts) replaces its created-at drawer filter with chips: currency, has balance, balance range, created at (old CreatedAt.From/To links still work). Positions (/positions) and departments (/departments) lists get chips too: department and status for positions; parent department (including none) and status for departments; the search form now pushes its state to the URL and infinite scroll keeps the conditions. New opt-in date presets this_quarter and last_quarter (filterq.PresetThisQuarter / PresetLastQuarter) for reports that close by quarter. filterbuilder.FieldDef.Single (filterq.Field.Single) limits a reference field to one value: a plain select in the editor, multi-value or duplicate conditions dropped on decode. Expense and payment categories replace their created-at drawer filter with a created-at chip; the project stages list (/project-stages) now really filters: chips for project, start, planned and factual end dates (with "not set") and created at, plus the existing search over description and stage number (projectstage.FindParams, Repository.Find/CountFound). filterq.LegacyDateRange turns former ?X.From=&X.To= links into a between chip.

MCP: lookup and describe entry points over the shared registry; transports publish only entry points once registered; execute is an entry point; Python bindings accept keyword-named parameters such as from.

Add notifications.AudienceSender (SendTx/Resolve) to send a notice to users, groups, roles, event participants, records and addresses in the caller transaction; event rules and explicit sends share the new AudienceResolver. Repositories may implement the optional notifications.DispatchFinder so replays return the first receipt. Rule-mode events may no longer use a DedupeKey starting with addressed:, which is reserved for explicit sends.

Accessibility contrast across SDK components (templ and Solid UI): form labels and tertiary text are gray-500; badge, alert, danger-button and error text use shades that reach 4.5:1 in both themes; outline and ghost buttons, nav tabs, segmented tabs and description-list rows read correctly in dark; progress text is dark on the green fill and the bar has an accessible name; Solid Dropdown triggers are no longer nested buttons and Combobox/SearchSelect reference an active option only while open. The whole Solid UI gallery now passes the axe gate in every state, theme and viewport.

Solid UI and templ toasts take one action ("Undo", "Retry") and use the light SDK surface with polite/alert announcements and a phone layout above bottom bars; Dialog and Drawer gain a busy state that refuses every close while a request runs; @iota-uz/sdk/testing adds expectNoA11yViolations (optional peer @axe-core/playwright); docs/automation-ui-standard.md defines the automation UI/UX acceptance standard.
